what: a ball joint driven to yaw 90 and pitch 90
method: Base: box 20x20x10 from (-10,-10,-10), grounded; Arm: box 40x10x10 from (0,-5,0), centre (20,0,5); ball with frame z = +z, x = +x: M = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rz(roll); Ry(90): (x,y,z) -> (z,y,-x), then Rz(90): (x,y) -> (-y,x): (20,0,5) -> (5,0,-20) -> (0,5,-20); box x -5..5, y 0..10, z -40..0
